rationale: Final status, no new records. Both investigations of this run are complete, coherent and cited only to retained receipts, and the last change repaired the one internal contradiction that remained. Configuration recovery (98ee8dfd5fac4b84915f91ed4b094bcf-question-0, conclusion violated, defect asserted) rests on seven receipts: the four single-voter recovery cases with flag-off controls (9a373c13...), the three-voter commit-rule witness that committed with a removed server's acknowledgement (79a9cc34..., reproduced in four receipts), the durable-snapshot corruption that survived a flag-off restart (c477da09...), the authority pair - original (4178d9d5...), a repeat that lacked its premise (fe822d82...) and a revised execution that enforces it (67fc59b5...) - and the two-voter probe showing the node still votes for a healthy peer (b9992882...). Replay completion (29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-question-0, conclusion violated, defect asserted) rests on eleven receipts: the block pair (3d04552f...), the measured bound pair (e82594cc..., repeated as 962196ed...), the availability consequence at two batch sizes (ebb3bb9f..., fe822d82..., 67fc59b5..., 7ac7e4f6...), the exact boundary at two batch sizes (8a710c75..., repeated as 9039d268..., extended as f394d835...) and the default-configuration pair (0cb30b6b..., repeated as 9039d268...). A consistency check of 54 claims across 14 retained receipts found no discrepancy; the two knowledge corrections this evidence raised (tuple-counted batching, randomized snapshot cadence) are recorded with their affected uses marked and their gaps answered. Remaining limits are structural: in-memory transports and stores in one process for all cases, no production store, no process-level restart or disk fault, one prefix shape per scenario, and the snapshot-shipping propagation path left unexercised; with the allocation nearly exhausted, no probe that could not be cited is started, and expiry preserves this state as it stands.
